scope.observer_status: Follow-up reader was shown both prior reports and reconciliation; no third blind adjudication or palaeographic certification.

tiff.access_detail: OrdinaryHTTP request returned200HTMLstaging, notTIFF. This was preserved; pre-detail acquisition amendment allowed one normal browser visit. Correct fixed URL then downloaded1006194.tif successfully.

confirmation_basis: Same left large multicolour diagram and right circular diagram; same fold/gutter, left binding, right-diagram lower-left stain, lower-edge holes/marks and outer paper silhouette.
pdf202.assessment: Same photographic composition/source image reproduced at lower pixel dimensions; not an independent historical witness. Exact downstream encoding/resampling pipeline not reconstructed.

photographic_independence.assessment: All three are consistent with the same Yale photograph1006194. TIFF/JPEG have identical frame and pixel dimensions with matching fine paper/stain locations; PDF repeats its composition and imageID at lower resolution.
photographic_independence.caveat: Common photograph is a source/visual identification, not a claim all decoded pixels are identical; no image-registration pipeline was fitted.

jpeg_tiff_decoded_comparison.scope: Aligned same-size raw decodedRGB values; no ICC conversion, no resizing, no text/ink segmentation. Differences do not by themselves establish a different photograph.

viewing.whole_image_display_resize: JPEG andTIFF full4972x3738 tool previews were displayed at3660x2751; originals unchanged.
viewing.detail_views: All4 predeclared regions viewed in all3 sources:12 crops. JPEG/TIFF original pixel crops; PDF embeddedJPEG proportional source coordinates, roundedout, no resampling.
viewing.processing: No enhancement, contrast/color regrading, sharpening, reconstruction, line drawing or generativeAI. TIFF PNG/crops retain originalICC; decodedRGB comparison explicitly ignores displayICC conversion.

boundary_findings.observation: 一条细淡斜痕的局部可追踪，较易辨认的短段约在(3030,2260)至(3130,2140)；向内侧更长延伸处显著变淡并邻近/穿过文字笔迹，外端接近圆弧也不清楚。两路原端点显著错开，本次不能用该局部把两条预登记跨度合成同一完整分界。

traceable_local_segments.kind: visible faint oblique trace, consistent with drawn divider locally
traceable_local_segments.not_claimed: not a certified full radial boundary or pixel-perfect ink mask

boundary_findings.interruptions: 线变弱而与纸面纹理、相邻文字竞争；没有足够证据给出准确断裂的单像素起止。
boundary_findings.source_sensitivity: TIFF减少局部JPEG块状纹理但没有提供更高分辨率/第二次摄影；未使原定整段连续性可确认。PDF缩小后更难分开细痕与背景。

boundary_findings.observation: 固定窗口中可见很淡的斜向候选痕，但无法稳定从纸纹/较宽浅色带和近旁文字中分离出可认证的连贯墨线。候选范围大致在原图x2780..3130,y1690..1870；不能把这块包络当作观察到的线。
boundary_findings.interruptions: 原两套端点之间本就有约数十像素偏移；相邻污渍、浅色带与细纸纹使起止及线中断位置均不能可靠判定。
boundary_findings.source_sensitivity: JPEG和TIFF的同一低对比问题保留；PDF降低尺寸，不新增足以解决分歧的细节。

boundary_findings.observation: 横跨左侧外缘红字附近并进入图内的浅色脊/阴影在两高清编码中明显可见，大致由(2510,1465)延至(3180,1470)。它更像同一纸面折痕的连续视觉迹象；本次不能在其上或旁边独立分离出一条贯通的绘制墨线。

traceable_local_segments.kind: physical crease/ridge-like trace; not accepted as ink boundary
traceable_local_segments.not_claimed: The trace is not a confirmed sector separator.

boundary_findings.interruptions: 折痕可追踪，不等于墨线可追踪；墨线的独立起止与连续性仍NA，不能以折痕补线。
boundary_findings.source_sensitivity: TIFF未把折痕与可能的绘制线分开；PDF将细部进一步混合。

O06_findings.pixel_observation: O06包含真实可见的斜排红色笔迹；主笔迹粗略在x4570..4685,y1910..2100内。上下邻近红色文字也在预定context窗口可见；中间此段不是空白框。

nearest_guided_records.note: 近似框边界10px不足以支持精密断言；但整个O06红字区域仍未获覆盖。

O06_findings.source_locator_assignment_status: NA; only neighboring guided records listed, no glyph comparison used to assign source text.
O06_findings.source_sensitivity: Three files retain this red run; PDF is lowerresolution but shows its spatial presence. TIFF does not remove the stored reading-box coverage gap.

overall_conclusion.scope: Encoding/source sensitivity and visible-region documentation only; no scoring, no reclassification of old reports.

limitations: SameAI follow-up with prior reports exposed; not a blinded independent adjudicator.
Coordinates are approximate visual windows/segments, not expert ink masks; limited preview/display and monitor color handling remain.
No newphotograph, multispectral image, raking light or conservation examination.
PDF page itself is a modern wrapper around the same photograph; no second manuscript witness.
A visible red run outside stored boxes establishes a coverage gap only, not text-unit count.
No full twelve-sector boundary or linguistic/semantic qualification has been established.
